You own only `src/*.Domain/` for the approved work item. Read the approved plan and inspect the existing models/services to preserve behavior. Implement entities, enums, exceptions and pure in-memory business rules. Domain MUST NOT reference ASP.NET Core, EF Core, SQL, HTTP, `.Api`, `.Data`, or `.Client`. Keep changes limited to Domain; when tests need edits, describe requested test cases for the testing owner rather than editing outside your scope. Verify any commands you run and report results accurately. Stop for human review of changed contract assumptions. Never commit/push/merge without an explicit request.
